items.summary: Ensure the app uses only local-session authentication in the user experience (no Internet Identity login prompts/redirects), and remove any remaining Internet Identity-dependent auth flow from non-immutable frontend code paths.

Update backend admin provisioning logic so that the admin usernames "sayedbaquar" and "bharatnikam" are recognized as admins, and fix the current mismatch that prevents successful admin creation/approval due to the hardcoded allowlist values ("Admin Name1", "Admin Name2").

Set the backend admin signup password to exactly "Hans@987123" and ensure it applies to all admin accounts (including "sayedbaquar" and "bharatnikam") wherever the admin signup password is still used.
Remove the "admin special password" requirement from the admin signup UX and backend gate so that admin-eligible users are not blocked by an extra special-password step during signup.
